verdict.rationale: Mailgun's Route Management lets users define rules for incoming email that automatically trigger actions such as forwarding or storing. Community users confirm it lets you apply rules before messages hit your servers. Webhooks push real-time events so apps can automate responses, and n8n integration extends this to no-code workflows. Missing for 10: native rules are documented only for inbound email (outbound events like bounces or clicks need webhooks plus your own code or n8n), there is no detail on rule expression or matching syntax, and nothing shows rules being defined by an AI agent (e.g., via MCP).
